# freePS (psdrawing.com)

> 100% free, client-side online PSD & PSB viewer, converter, and multi-layer photo editor. Open Adobe Photoshop (.PSD and .PSB) files directly in your web browser without installing software or uploading files to any server.

freePS is a browser-based graphic utility and photo editing suite. Homepage: https://psdrawing.com/

## Core Tools & Converters

- [freePS Homepage - Online PSD Viewer & Photo Editor](https://psdrawing.com/): Drag-and-drop PSD/PSB viewer, quick exporter, and multi-layer graphics editor.
- [PSD to PNG, JPG & WEBP Converter](https://psdrawing.com/psd-viewer): Convert Photoshop files to lossless PNG, JPG, or WEBP and inspect file headers.
- [Convert PSD to PDF Online Free](https://psdrawing.com/psd-to-pdf): Client-side PSD to PDF document converter with zero server uploads.
- [Extract & Inspect PSD Layers Online](https://psdrawing.com/extract-psd-layers): View embedded PSD layer names, dimensions, bit depth, and color modes.
- [Online PSB Viewer (Large Document Format)](https://psdrawing.com/psb-viewer): Open Version 2 (64-bit) Adobe Photoshop .PSB files in the browser.
- [freePS Multi-Layer Studio Workspace](https://psdrawing.com/editor): Full in-browser image editor with layers, brushes, filters, and clone stamp.
